dashboard.label: Gear and Sports
dashboard.description: Recorded gear usage can be incomplete. Names are preserved; correct aliases through overrides. No combined pace is calculated across sports. Annual panels use full snapshot history; Full years includes a partial latest year. Comparable YTD ends each year at the import calendar date. Annual speed is distance divided by moving time, in km/h or MPH. Skiing summaries do not isolate descents from lifts or traverses.
